I2-004.scope: Select maximum displacement among represented waterline cases; not physical measurement or whole-waterline geometry.
I2-004.source_precondition: UR I2 applies to Polar Class ships; design-record eligibility is an explicit pilot precondition, not derived from missing RDF selectors.

obligations.description: For a single represented case use its displacement; for multiple cases the selected UIWL displacement is the greatest. The rule does not demand multiple cases.

contract_patch.comparisonModel: upperIceWaterlineDisplacement equals the maximum of represented linked waterlineCaseDisplacement quantities, in canonical kilotonnes; one case is allowed.

source.exact_excerpt:
I2.1.2.2 The ship displacement DUI is the displacement, in kt, of the ship corresponding to the
            upper ice waterline (UIWL). Where multiple waterlines are used for determining the UIWL, the
            displacement is to be determined from the waterline corresponding to the greatest
            displacement.

I2-042.scope: Subclause (i) minimum flange/web ratio only. Full source limits the clause to welded profiles; generic structuralMember inventory does not establish this eligibility.
I2-042.source_precondition: Polar Class population plus welded-profile applicability; the latter is not represented by an explicit selector or scoped member class.

obligations.description: For applicable welded profiles, flange width is not less than five times net web thickness; equality is permitted. Do not reverse the inequality or require a member instance from this universal alone.

blocking_issues.detail: Source I2.9.4 qualifies welded profiles; neither structuralMember, hasStructuralMember nor the locked requirement contract identifies welded profiles. Do not map structuralSectionType to welding fabrication or invent a boolean.
blocking_issues.proposed_correction: Obtain an explicit source/representation decision for a welded-profile selector, class, or scoped input inventory and then review applicability cases; until then do not dispatch this requirement.

source.exact_excerpt:
I2.9.4 To prevent local flange buckling of welded profiles, the following are to be satisfied:

         (i) The flange width, bf [mm], is not to be less than five times the net thickness of the web,
         twn.

obligations.description: If designIceCondition is the locked at-least-medium condition, shipCategory is Category A. Other represented conditions do not require A under this requirement; do not add a converse.
